data.display_address: Palace Residences North, Dubai Creek Harbour (The Lagoons), Dubai
data.long_description:
Apartment for rent in Palace Residence North, located in the prestigious Dubai Creek Harbour community.

Property Details:

• 3 Bedrooms
• 4 Bathrooms
• Size: 1,663 sqft
• 2 Parking Spaces
• Brand new – first tenant
This spacious apartment features a bright open-plan living and dining area with floor-to-ceiling windows, allowing plenty of natural light and offering beautiful community and Creek views. The modern kitchen is fully fitted with high-quality finishes, designed for both style and functionality.
All bedrooms come with built-in wardrobes, while the master bedroom includes an en-suite bathroom. The unit also offers a maid’s room with attached bathroom, along with dedicated laundry and storage spaces for added convenience. A private balcony completes the home, providing a relaxing outdoor space.

Amenities:

• Swimming pool
• Fully equipped gym
• Children’s play area
• BBQ and leisure areas
• Waterfront promenade access
• 24/7 security

Location Highlights:

• 10 minutes to Downtown Dubai
• 15 minutes to Dubai International Airport (DXB)
• 15 minutes to Dubai Mall
• 20 minutes to Business Bay
• 25 minutes to Dubai Marina

Located in a vibrant waterfront community, residents enjoy a premium lifestyle with easy access to retail, dining, and major landmarks across Dubai.
At Provident Real Estate, we focus on understanding each client’s needs to deliver a tailored property experience, ensuring the right match for both end-users and investors.
